git_sha_scope: Repository packaging and collector code; historical engine inputs, image IDs and source hashes are recorded inside the archive
archive_layout: calibration-evidence/ contains runs/, batches/, quoted snapshots, source-build evidence, licences and file-index.json
archive_generation: Sorted regular files; tar metadata has uid/gid/mtime zero and mode 0644; gzip mtime zero and empty filename
validation_scope: Saved pipeline/internal-consistency and convergence evidence; no electronic model is accuracy-qualified for potential fitting
omitted_large_artifacts: Integrals, R-matrix amplitudes and K-matrices; these can be recomputed from the recipes
historical_snapshot_coverage: Nine batches retain source snapshots. The four earliest batches retain source hashes, molecular decks, templates and generated program inputs but not every Python harness revision
